# Implement Love Mail button functionality (2025-11-14 00:09Z)

_**User (2025-11-13 16:52Z)**_

The app is working great — everything looks solid so far.
I’d like to implement a feature where clicking the Love Mail button refreshes Page 1 and resets it to its original layout and format, as shown in the attached image. This gives users a clean slate to create a new message and maintains a consistent experience.
Once an Update Love Mail is created, it should overwrite the content on Page 1. If the user wants to start fresh again, clicking the Love Mail button should reset Page 1 back to its default state — matching the original design and content structure.

Implementation complete. Summary:

1. **Added `resetData()` function** to the storage utility — clears all localStorage data and dispatches the update event.

2. **Updated Header component** — clicking "Love Mail" on the home page resets all data and refreshes the page.

3. **Automatic refresh** — the home page listens to the `lovemail-data-updated` event, so when data is reset, it updates and shows the default content.

When users click "Love Mail" on the home page:
- All stored data (notes, tasks, calendar events) is cleared
- The page refreshes to show the default content (the original layout with default notes, tasks, and calendar events)
- Users get a clean slate to create a new message

When users create an "Update Love Mail", it overwrites the content on Page 1 (already working via localStorage). If they want to start fresh, clicking "Love Mail" resets everything back to the default state.

The feature is ready to use. The reset works seamlessly with the existing data sync system.
